title: Enrollment response
description: 200: the signed certificate. Errors use {error, detail} with HTTP 400 bad_request (body fails the request schema) | csr_invalid | device_mismatch | chip_mismatch, 401 token_invalid | token_expired, 409 token_used, 429 rate_limited. Retrying with the same token and the same public key within 24 h returns the same certificate (200), so a lost response is safe to retry.

cert.description: Leaf certificate, CN = device_id, clientAuth EKU.

ca_chain.description: Device intermediate (and nothing else). The device presents leaf + chain to the broker.
